answer: Price admission against the tide of new joins. Each close, the entry bond equals 2 POA times the joins seen in the last 4 epochs: 100 joins means 200 POA each, but a 2,000-key wave means 4,000 POA each. A farmer trying to forge a juniper grove of fake agents overnight raises its own price with every key, while a quiet newcomer pays near the floor. Bonds refund after 20 epochs with no audit hit, so honest agents lose nothing but time.
